eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无需账号 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
?
一条命令告诉你哪层配错了
headline.en:
Your local model feels dumb?
One command tells you which layer is off

sub.zh: 12 个行为探针对照每模型已知正确配置，把
的差距归因到具体的配置层。
sub.en: 12 behavioral probes diff against per-model known-good configs — attributing felt dumbness to a specific misconfiguration layer.

body.zh: 不用再逐个试重量化、换上下文、调采样器。一句话告诉你损失出在 chat-template 还是 sampling，附带量化能力损失估计。
body.en: Stop re-quantizing, swapping context, and tuning samplers one by one. One line tells you whether the loss is in chat-template or sampling, with a quantified capability-loss estimate.

body.zh: 内置 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek 的正确配置基准：标准 chat-template 名称、标准采样参数、12 个探针的已知正确响应模式。
body.en: Baked-in known-good reference data for Qwen3 and DeepSeek: canonical chat-template names, standard sampler defaults, and known-good probe response patterns.

body.zh: 跑完探针直接输出一行结论，可以截图发帖——看起来是测量归因，不是
body.en: After probing, it prints a single verdict line you can screenshot and post — it reads as measured attribution, not "yet another CLI tool."

body.zh: 10 个错误配置 + 10 个正确配置，验证双层归因准确率远超随机猜测。
body.en: 10 mis-set + 10 correctly-set cases validate that 2-layer attribution accuracy far exceeds random guess.

sub.zh: 免费 · 开源 · 只需要一个本地模型服务器
sub.en: Free · open-source · just needs a local model server
